description: This file defines the Invoice class for the vtiger CRM system, including methods for saving, retrieving related activities, history, status history, report queries, and handling recurring invoices. It manages invoice data and relationships within the CRM.

classes.name: Invoice
classes.description: Represents an invoice entity in vtiger CRM with methods for managing invoice data, relationships, history, and recurring invoice creation.

methods.name: Invoice
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles saving invoice data, updating related sales order status, and creating recurring invoices if applicable.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the invoice's summary text, typically its name.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities related to the invoice.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Fetches activity history related to the invoice.

methods.name: get_invoicestatushistory
methods.description: Retrieves the status change history of the invoice.

methods.name: get_column_value
methods.description: Overrides base method to handle specific column value retrieval.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary query parts for report related to the invoice.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationships between the invoice and other entities.

methods.name: createRecurringInvoiceFromSO
methods.description: Creates a recurring invoice from a sales order, copying related products, taxes, and updating stock.
